title: 实验服与防护服
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/024_实验服与防护服.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/024_实验服与防护服/src.py

points.K1: 实验服是防护用品，进门就穿
points.K2: 实验服选棉质或阻燃材质
points.K3: 明火、自燃试剂和火花：穿阻燃服
points.K4: 扣子扣好，袖口塞进手套
points.K5: 有喷溅，加穿耐化学品围裙
points.K6: 防护服按危害选，沾污就换
points.K7: 实验服不出实验室，不带回家洗
points.S1: 大量沾染，立即脱下冲洗

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣穿着扣好的白色实验服，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a fully buttoned white lab coat waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验服与防护服。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰穿着敞开的实验服，里面是化纤运动衫，袖口卷起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears an unbuttoned lab coat over a synthetic sports shirt, sleeves rolled up.
shots.narration: 阿杰的实验服敞着，袖子也卷起来。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰穿着实验服走向食堂门口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in his lab coat walks toward a canteen entrance.
shots.narration: 下了课，他穿着实验服就去吃饭。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研叫住他，指指他的实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls him back and points at his lab coat.
shots.narration: 小研说：实验服可不是这么穿的。

shots.section_title: 实验服是防护用品，进门就穿
shots.scene: 液滴溅来，先落在实验服上，皮肤完好
shots.prompt_en: A splash of droplets lands on a lab coat sleeve instead of the skin underneath. No faces.
shots.narration: 溅出的液滴，先落在实验服上。
overlay: 实验服是防护用品，进门就穿

shots.section_title: 实验服是防护用品，进门就穿
shots.scene: 实验服挂在门口衣钩上，学生进门先穿上
shots.prompt_en: A student takes a lab coat from a hook by the lab door and puts it on before entering. No faces.
shots.narration: 一进实验室，就穿上实验服。

shots.section_title: 实验服是防护用品，进门就穿
shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套组成一组防护图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, goggles and gloves grouped together as protective equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服也是个人防护用品。

shots.section_title: 实验服是防护用品，进门就穿
shots.scene: 实验服价格标签小，旁边是被保护的人形轮廓
shots.prompt_en: A small price tag on a lab coat next to a protected body outline. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 花钱不多，却能大大提高安全。

shots.section_title: 实验服选棉质或阻燃材质
shots.scene: 棉质实验服和阻燃实验服并排，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A cotton lab coat and a flame-resistant lab coat side by side with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服选棉质或阻燃材质。
overlay: 实验服选棉质或阻燃材质

shots.section_title: 实验服选棉质或阻燃材质
shots.scene: 化纤面料遇热熔化成滴的示意，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of synthetic fabric melting into drips near heat, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化纤遇火会熔化，粘在皮肤上。

shots.section_title: 实验服选棉质或阻燃材质
shots.scene: 实验服下面的化纤毛衣被打叉，换成棉质衣服
shots.prompt_en: A synthetic sweater under a lab coat is crossed out and replaced by cotton clothing. No people.
shots.narration: 里面的衣服，也别选化纤。

shots.section_title: 实验服选棉质或阻燃材质
shots.scene: 实验服长度盖过膝盖，袖子盖住手腕
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat that reaches below the knees with sleeves covering the wrists. No people.
shots.narration: 长度过膝，长袖盖住手腕。

shots.section_title: 明火、自燃试剂和火花：穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 普通棉质实验服的衣角着火持续燃烧
shots.prompt_en: The hem of an ordinary cotton lab coat catches fire and keeps burning. No people.
shots.narration: 普通棉质实验服，着火会持续燃烧。
overlay: 明火、自燃试剂和火花：穿阻燃服

shots.section_title: 明火、自燃试剂和火花：穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 阻燃实验服离开火焰后火自己熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A flame-resistant lab coat is pulled away from a flame and self-extinguishes. No people.
shots.narration: 阻燃服，离火就能自熄。

shots.section_title: 明火、自燃试剂和火花：穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 自燃试剂瓶、明火、高能反应三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a pyrophoric reagent bottle, an open flame and an energetic reaction flask. No people.
shots.narration: 自燃试剂、明火、高能反应，穿阻燃服。

shots.section_title: 明火、自燃试剂和火花：穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 一件被烧坏的化纤毛衣和警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A burned synthetic sweater beside a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 曾有人穿化纤衣服处理自燃试剂，严重烧伤。

shots.section_title: 明火、自燃试剂和火花：穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 焊接火花飞向阻燃工作服，扣好领口
shots.prompt_en: Welding sparks fly toward a flame-resistant work jacket with the collar buttoned. No faces.
shots.narration: 焊接切割有火花，穿阻燃工作服。

shots.section_title: 明火、自燃试剂和火花：穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 王老师把阻燃服挂在专用位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hangs flame-resistant lab coats on a dedicated rack.
shots.narration: 需要阻燃服的工作，写进风险评估。

shots.section_title: 扣子扣好，袖口塞进手套
shots.scene: 敞开的实验服，液体溅到里面的衣服，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An open lab coat lets a splash reach the clothes underneath, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 敞着怀，等于没穿。
overlay: 扣子扣好，袖口塞进手套

shots.section_title: 扣子扣好，袖口塞进手套
shots.scene: 【实拍】从下到上扣好实验服全部扣子，再把袖口塞进手套（正面中景，不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: A person buttons a lab coat all the way up, then tucks the sleeve cuffs into nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 扣子全部扣好，袖口塞进手套。

shots.section_title: 扣子扣好，袖口塞进手套
shots.scene: 卷起的袖子露出手臂，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Rolled-up lab coat sleeves exposing forearms, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 袖子不卷起，手腕不外露。

shots.section_title: 扣子扣好，袖口塞进手套
shots.scene: 宽松袖口勾倒烧杯的示意，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A loose, flapping sleeve knocks over a beaker, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 袖口别松垮，免得勾倒器皿。

shots.section_title: 有喷溅，加穿耐化学品围裙
shots.scene: 腐蚀品液滴落在手臂上留下灼伤图标
shots.prompt_en: A corrosive droplet lands on a forearm icon, leaving a burn mark. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀品溅到皮肤，会造成灼伤。
overlay: 有喷溅，加穿耐化学品围裙

shots.section_title: 有喷溅，加穿耐化学品围裙
shots.scene: 实验服外再系一条耐化学品围裙
shots.prompt_en: A chemical-resistant apron is tied over a lab coat. No faces.
shots.narration: 飞溅风险大，加一条耐化学品围裙。

shots.section_title: 有喷溅，加穿耐化学品围裙
shots.scene: 处理浓酸、挥发性和活泼溶液的三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a concentrated acid bottle, a volatile solvent and a reactive solution. No people.
shots.narration: 浓酸、易挥发、活泼溶液，都要加。

shots.section_title: 有喷溅，加穿耐化学品围裙
shots.scene: 围裙被溅上后，解开带子迅速脱下
shots.prompt_en: A splashed apron is quickly untied and removed. No faces.
shots.narration: 溅上了，一解就能脱下。

shots.section_title: 有喷溅，加穿耐化学品围裙
shots.scene: 围裙、手套、护目镜加面屏组合在一起
shots.prompt_en: An apron, gloves, goggles and a face shield shown as one protective set. No people.
shots.narration: 围裙配合手套和眼面防护一起用。

shots.section_title: 防护服按危害选，沾污就换
shots.scene: 防水防护服挡住喷溅，水珠滑落
shots.prompt_en: Liquid splash beads up and runs off a waterproof protective suit. No faces.
shots.narration: 挡飞溅的防护服，要能防水。
overlay: 防护服按危害选，沾污就换

shots.section_title: 防护服按危害选，沾污就换
shots.scene: 高温、化学品、近水三个图标分别配不同防护服
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, heat, chemicals and water, each paired with a different protective suit. No people.
shots.narration: 高温、化学品、近水，各有防护服。

shots.section_title: 防护服按危害选，沾污就换
shots.scene: 路边采样的人穿着反光背心
shots.prompt_en: A person collecting samples beside a road wears a reflective safety vest.
shots.narration: 车多、光线暗，穿反光衣。

shots.section_title: 防护服按危害选，沾污就换
shots.scene: 沾污的防护服放进指定收集袋
shots.prompt_en: A contaminated protective suit is placed into a designated collection bag. No faces.
shots.narration: 沾污了，立即放到指定地点。

shots.section_title: 防护服按危害选，沾污就换
shots.scene: 换上干净的防护服，回到工作台
shots.prompt_en: A person puts on a clean protective suit and returns to the bench. No faces.
shots.narration: 换上干净的，再回去工作。

shots.section_title: 实验服不出实验室，不带回家洗
shots.scene: 穿实验服走进食堂、宿舍、会议室，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat figure entering a canteen, a dormitory and a meeting room, crossed out with red X marks. No faces.
shots.narration: 别穿实验服去食堂、宿舍、办公室。
overlay: 实验服不出实验室，不带回家洗

shots.section_title: 实验服不出实验室，不带回家洗
shots.scene: 实验服挂在实验室专区，和便服分开
shots.prompt_en: Lab coats hang in a designated lab area, separate from personal jackets. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服挂在专区，不和便服混放。

shots.section_title: 实验服不出实验室，不带回家洗
shots.scene: 【实拍】脱实验服时外面朝里卷起，放进专用收集袋（中景，不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: A person takes off a lab coat, rolls it with the outside folded in, and puts it into a collection bag.
shots.narration: 脱下时外面朝里，装进专用袋。

shots.section_title: 实验服不出实验室，不带回家洗
shots.scene: 家用洗衣机和宿舍被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A home washing machine and a dormitory icon crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不带回家，不带回宿舍洗。

shots.section_title: 实验服不出实验室，不带回家洗
shots.scene: 收集袋送去统一消毒、清洗
shots.prompt_en: Bagged lab coats are collected for disinfection and laundering. No people.
shots.narration: 由单位统一消毒、清洗。

shots.section_title: 实验服不出实验室，不带回家洗
shots.scene: 沾了菌液的实验服先消毒再清洗的流程图
shots.prompt_en: A flow diagram: a lab coat stained with culture liquid, a disinfection icon, then a washing icon. No people.
shots.narration: 沾了菌液，先消毒再统一洗。

shots.section_title: 大量沾染，立即脱下冲洗
shots.scene: 大量化学品泼到实验服上
shots.prompt_en: A large amount of liquid splashes onto a lab coat. No faces.
shots.narration: 大量化学品泼到身上怎么办？
overlay: 大量沾染，立即脱下冲洗

shots.section_title: 大量沾染，立即脱下冲洗
shots.scene: 迅速脱下污染的实验服和衣物
shots.prompt_en: A person quickly removes a contaminated lab coat. No faces.
shots.narration: 立即脱下污染的实验服和衣物。

shots.section_title: 大量沾染，立即脱下冲洗
shots.scene: 紧急喷淋下冲洗身体
shots.prompt_en: A person rinses under an emergency safety shower. No faces.
shots.narration: 到紧急喷淋下，持续冲洗。

shots.section_title: 大量沾染，立即脱下冲洗
shots.scene: 小研向老周报告，指向急救图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man and points toward a first aid icon.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人，及时就医。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 棉质或阻燃实验服、扣好的扣子、围裙依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A cotton or flame-resistant lab coat, fastened buttons and an apron get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 选对材质，扣好穿好，喷溅加围裙。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 实验服挂专区、统一清洗打勾，食堂和家用洗衣机打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat rack and a laundry bag get checks; a canteen and a home washing machine get red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不穿出实验室，不带回家洗。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一个口罩，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a respirator mask and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲呼吸防护。
